title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.7 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9,…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab CE/EE versions from 11.7 up to but not including 19.4.11, 19.5 up to 19.5.9, and 19.6 up to 19.6.2 could allow an authenticated user with Maintainer role permissions to cause a denial of service. This issue arises from missing resource limits in the error tracking integration. The vulnerability has been remediated in the specified fixed versions.
